description: §14.8.10 (S456) — a program-body `?{CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS invoices (…, tenant_id TEXT)}` whose table no `<schema>` / `<db tables=>` declares. Before S456 `invoices` was outside the compilation's tenant set, so its reads were emitted unscoped (every tenant's rows to every request) with no diagnostic (compiled clean on 2dd6d35d9). Now refused at compile.
rationale: §14.8.10 (ruling user-voice-scrml.md S456 "b, startup check lands with it"): a table carrying a `tenant_id` column that is not in the compilation's tenant set is refused where the compiler can see it — a program-body `?{CREATE [TEMP] TABLE … tenant_id …}` is E-TENANT-UNDECLARED.
